items.title: Deepgram acquires Pipecat-maker Daily to bolster its voice AI infrastructure
items.summary: Deepgram said that it is committed to keep Pipecat open source.
items.creator: Ivan Mehta

items.title: Amazon updates Alexa to help you manage shopping lists, subscriptions, and update delivery instructions
items.summary: The update allows you to use Alexa to create lists, register them, see what's on them, and add or edit items. You can also manage subscriptions with the AI bot.
items.creator: Ivan Mehta

items.title: Who will you learn from in 6 days at TechCrunch Founder Summit? Meet the founders and investors taking the stages
items.summary: Six days from now, TechCrunch Founder Summit brings experienced founders, investors, and operators to Boston on Nov. 4 to share the decisions, mistakes, pivots, and lessons that shaped their companies. Register before it starts for ticket savings and deals.
items.creator: TechCrunch Events
